description: Header file defining the LocalTracer class and related classes for messaging and tracing within the Thunder namespace, including callback interface, singleton management, worker thread, and console printing.

classes.name: LocalTracer
classes.description: Main class managing message tracing, singleton pattern, worker thread, and callback handling.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class for message unit settings configuration.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: Worker thread class for dispatching messages.

classes.name: ConsolePrinter
classes.description: Implementation of ICallback that outputs messages to console.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Open
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LocalTracer, initializing message unit and directory.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Close
methods.description: Closes and deletes the singleton instance, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: LocalTracer::EnableMessage
methods.description: Enables or disables tracing for a specific module and category.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Dispatch
methods.description: Processes incoming messages and calls the callback.

methods.name: LocalTracer::Callback
methods.description: Sets the callback handler for messages.
